stemMd: Two solid blocks at different temperatures are placed in thermal contact in an insulated system. Initially, net heat flows in which direction?

options.label: A
options.textMd: From the colder to the hotter without work input

options.label: B
options.textMd: From the heavier block regardless of temperature

options.label: C
options.textMd: There is no transfer unless both are liquids

options.label: D
options.textMd: From the hotter block to the colder block

options.label: E
options.textMd: From the smaller block regardless of temperature

explanationMd: A temperature difference drives spontaneous heat transfer from hot to cold. Mass and heat capacity affect the eventual equilibrium temperature, not this initial direction.

distractorRationale.b: Mass does not determine the initial direction.
distractorRationale.e: Size does not determine the direction.
